AbstractText.Label: OBJECTIVE
AbstractText.content: to present the indicators' projection method of the Strategic Action Plan for Tackling Chronic Non-Communicable Diseases (NCDs) in Brazilian State capitals and the Federal District, 2012-2022.

AbstractText.Label: METHODS
AbstractText.content: simple linear regression model was used to calculate the indicators' projections with data from the Surveillance System of Risk and Protective Factors for Chronic Diseases by Telephone Survey (Vigitel).

AbstractText.Label: RESULTS
AbstractText.content: in most of the capitals, there was an increase in the prevalence of obesity (annual change: 0.36%;1.29%), overweight (annual change: 1.11%;2.00%), recommended (annual change: 1.45%;2.66%) and regular (annual change: 0.45%;1.46%) consumption of fruits and vegetables; smoking presented a decreasing trend (annual change: -1.34%;-0.20%); whereas physical inactivity, heavy drinking and mammography and Pap smears examinations were stable.

AbstractText.Label: CONCLUSION
AbstractText.content: most of the goals are possible; however, effective actions are necessary, especially for tackling overweight and heavy drinking.
